integracion.whatsapp.page.problem.body: No. We connect your current number to Meta's official API, or give you a new one if you'd rather keep the automated channel separate from your personal one. integracion.whatsapp.page.how.step1.body: Your number is registered with the official WhatsApp Business API inside your own Meta Business account. The account is in your name: you own it, we only have access to configure it.
integracion.whatsapp.page.how.step2.titl: 2. We train the agent on your information
integracion.whatsapp.page.how.step2.body: We load your real services, prices, hours, and FAQs. The agent answers with your data, not generic information, and we define what it should NOT answer.
integracion.whatsapp.page.how.step3.titl: 3. It starts replying and you see everything
integracion.whatsapp.page.how.step3.body: Every message arrives through a secure webhook, the agent replies within seconds, and the conversation is logged. From your dashboard you see full threads, customers who asked for a human, and the appointments that got booked.
integracion.whatsapp.page.usecases.title: What happens under the hood with each message
integracion.whatsapp.page.usecases.item1: Meta sends the message cryptographically signed. If the signature doesn't match, it's rejected: nobody can inject fake messages into your account.
integracion.whatsapp.page.usecases.item2: If that phone number was already one of your leads, the conversation joins their record instead of creating a duplicate. If it's new, it's added automatically.
integracion.whatsapp.page.usecases.item3: It answers the question, quotes your real prices, offers available time slots, or books. If the case goes beyond what it can resolve, it flags the conversation for a human.
integracion.whatsapp.page.usecases.item4: If Meta retries the delivery, the system recognizes the message and doesn't reply twice. The whole thread is saved so you can review it later.
integracion.whatsapp.page.faq.q0: How much does sending messages cost?
integracion.whatsapp.page.faq.a0: When a customer writes to you, your reply within the next 24 hours has no per-message cost: it only counts against your plan's conversations. Meta only charges for templates, which are messages YOU start outside that window (reminders, promotions). If you need those, we tell you the cost up front.
integracion.whatsapp.page.faq.q1: What do I need to have ready?
integracion.whatsapp.page.faq.a1: A number that can receive a verification code, a Meta Business account (we help you create one if you don't have it), and the information you want the agent to answer with. That's it. Full setup takes 3 to 5 business days.
integracion.whatsapp.page.faq.q2: Does it connect with my current system?
integracion.whatsapp.page.faq.a2: Yes. The agent can check your calendar to offer real availability, send customer details to your CRM, and notify you by email. If you use another platform, we connect it as long as it can be integrated; we check that in the demo before committing to anything.
integracion.whatsapp.page.cta.title: We'll show it working with your case
integracion.whatsapp.page.cta.body: In the demo we wire up an example with your real information so you can see how it would answer your customers before you sign up.
integracion.whatsapp.title: Your WhatsApp, answering on its own
integracion.whatsapp.body: The same number your customers already use, replying instantly at any hour, with your information, and without anyone having to watch their phone.
